tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: No respiratory viruses detected by nucleic acid amplification in the specimen. The results suggest absence of acute infection with the tested viruses (influenza A/B, RSV, parainfluenza 1-3, rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, adenovirus) at the time of sampling. Correlate with clinical findings for further management.
